user.title: UK Fuel Finder Setup
user.description:
Enter your API credentials.

Get your Client ID and Client Secret at:
[Fuel Finder Developer Portal]({developer_portal_url})

Optionally set a default location below — you can add more locations later from the integration's Options menu.

add_location.title: Add Location
add_location.description:
Define a location to search for fuel prices around.

**Static**: enter fixed coordinates.
**Device Tracker**: select a device_tracker entity (e.g. mobile phone) — the location updates automatically.

data_description.name: A friendly name for this location (e.g. "Home", "Work").
data_description.location_source: "Static" for fixed coordinates, "Device Tracker" to follow a mobile device.
data_description.latitude: Required when using a static location source.
data_description.longitude: Required when using a static location source.
data_description.radius: How far to search for stations, 0.1-50 km.
data_description.update_interval: How often prices are refreshed, 5-1440 minutes.
data_description.fuel_types: Sensors are only created for the selected fuel types.
data_description.entity_id: e.g. device_tracker.mobile_app. Leave blank for static locations.
